items.name: Chapinería Open 2027
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjMyMzU4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--145408a7a4c01909fa0bed8fda14d9b6e0d538f9/ChapiOpenV5.jpg)
¡Bienvenidos al Chapinería Open 2027! El sábado 13 de febrero de 2027 llevamos el speedcubing a la Sierra Oeste de Madrid, con 8 categorías y 64 competidores.

**Adiós Clock**: El Clock deja de ser oficial después del Mundial de julio de 2027. ¡Aprovecha una de las últimas oportunidades! **Hola FTO**: El FTO será oficial en la WCA desde el 2 de enero de 2027, así que esta será una de las primeras competiciones de Madrid en las que se pueda conseguir un resultado oficial.

**Cronómetros en modo 4-pad**: Desde el 2 de enero de 2027, los intentos oficiales se hacen con el Speed Stacks G5 StackMat Pro en modo 4-pad. Si nunca lo has probado, tendremos una mesa de práctica abierta antes de empezar. No se puede comer ni beber en esa mesa.

------------------

Welcome to the Chapinería Open 2027! On Saturday, February 13, 2027, we are bringing speedcubing to Madrid’s Sierra Oeste, featuring 8 categories and 64 competitors.

**Goodbye Clock** Clock will no longer be an official event after the July 2027 World Championship. Make the most of one of your last chances to compete in it! **Hello FTO** FTO will officially join the WCA on January 2, 2027, making this one of the very first competitions in Madrid where you can register an official result.

**Timers in 4-Pad Mode**: Starting January 2, 2027, official attempts must be made using the Speed Stacks G5 StackMat Pro in 4-pad mode. If you have never tried it, we will have an open practice table available before the competition starts. Eating and drinking are strictly prohibited at the practice table.

items.name: For the Love of FMC 2027
items.information:
For the love of FMC 2027 will be held from **Saturday, February 13, 2027 at 15:00 UTC until Sunday, February 14, 2027 at 00:00 UTC**. Please pay attention to the date and time zone of your location.

Registration and locations can be found [here](https://fm.danskspeedcubingforening.dk/competitions/FortheLoveofFMC2027)

Locations may be added until **January 29, 2027 23:59 UTC** so if there isn't a location near you yet contact your local [Delegate](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/delegates).

Note: Registrations on the external website are up-to-date, but registrations will only be added to the WCA website periodically.

Attendance is not required for the entire competition. However, **please arrive at least 15 minutes before the events that you compete in or help in are planned to start**. Please bring your own puzzles for the events you are competing in.

**First-Time Competitors: All newcomers must be familiar with the WCA Regulations before competing.** There is a video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww&t=2s&ab_channel=cyotheking) for a basic overview of the rules.
